Disappointed
Mar 2019 • Couples
It was date night and we were looking forward to enjoying a higher quality restaurant experience than we usually do. The ambiance was nice when we arrived as we were only the second table to be seated but within half an hour it was packed full of very loud guests. Then our entree arrived and it was good quality sushi but within a few minutes the room was full of cigarette smoke. Yes, apparently it’s culturally acceptable to smoke inside a restaurant in Japan? (actually it just got ruled out only a few months ago). Not enjoyable while trying to eat a healthy meal!! I also get asthma so I had to leave and get my ventalin. (& a jacket as the aircon is turned up to be very cold) Upon my return we then had to wait for over 45 minutes for our main course (breathing more smoke). We decided to leave at 35 minutes as we had had enough and the staff, although sweet, asked us to wait. Five minutes more and we asked for the bill again. Instead main course arrived. I left anyway as I needed fresh air and waited outside for my husband. This was the most expensive meal we’d had in that street and the most disappointing. Better off going to any other restaurant! We were so disappointed.
